name: ChatGPT
priceDetail: 免费版可用 GPT-4o mini；Plus $20/月解锁 GPT-4o、绘画、高级语音；Team/Enterprise 按席位计费。
priceDetailEn: Free tier uses GPT-4o mini; Plus $20/mo unlocks GPT-4o, image gen, advanced voice; Team/Enterprise per seat.
summary: 全球最知名的对谈式 AI，写作、编程、分析全能，生态最成熟。
summaryEn: The most well-known conversational AI: writing, coding, analysis, biggest ecosystem.
strengths: 模型能力强且稳定；GPTs 生态与插件丰富；支持联网、绘图、代码解释器。
strengthsEn: Strong & stable model; rich GPTs/plugin ecosystem; web, image, code interpreter.
weaknesses: 免费版有限速；中文偶有西式表达；Plus 价格对轻度用户偏高。
weaknessesEn: Free tier rate-limited; occasionally westernized Chinese; Plus pricey for light users.
bestFor: 需要可靠全能助手、愿意为稳定质量付费的办公与创作者人群。
bestForEn: Users wanting a reliable all-rounder and willing to pay for stability.

name: 豆包
priceDetail: 字节旗下，App 与网页端对话免费，PC 端体验流畅。
priceDetailEn: By ByteDance; free chat on App and web, smooth PC experience.
summary: 字节出品的免费中文助手，响应快、接地气，日常问答很顺手。
summaryEn: ByteDance's free Chinese assistant; fast, casual, great for daily Q&A.
strengths: 完全免费；中文口语化自然；App 体验好；与抖音生态联动。
strengthsEn: Completely free; natural colloquial Chinese; good App; Douyin ecosystem.
weaknesses: 深度推理弱于头部推理模型；专业长文能力一般。
weaknessesEn: Weaker deep reasoning; mediocre long-form professional writing.
bestFor: 不想花钱、要个随时能聊能查的轻量中文助手的用户。
bestForEn: Users who want a free, lightweight Chinese chat assistant.

name: Midjourney
priceDetail: Basic $10/月（约200张）；Standard $30/月；Pro $60/月。无免费额度。
priceDetailEn: Basic $10/mo (~200 imgs); Standard $30; Pro $60. No free tier.
summary: 画质与审美天花板级的图像生成，艺术/概念图首选。
summaryEn: Top-tier image quality & aesthetics; go-to for art/concept art.
strengths: 出图审美领先；风格统一；社区与参考图丰富。
strengthsEn: Leading aesthetics; consistent style; rich community refs.
weaknesses: 纯订阅无免费；中文提示词理解一般；需 Discord/网页操作。
weaknessesEn: Subscription only; average Chinese prompt understanding; Discord/web UI.
bestFor: 插画师、设计师、需要高质量概念图与海报的创作者。
bestForEn: Illustrators, designers needing high-quality concept art.

name: 即梦
priceDetail: 日常生成有免费额度；会员解锁更高清晰度与去水印。
priceDetailEn: Daily free quota; membership unlocks HD & watermark removal.
summary: 字节的 AI 绘画+短视频生成，免费额度友好，中文提示词顺手。
summaryEn: ByteDance's AI image + short-video gen; friendly free quota, good Chinese prompts.
strengths: 免费额度足；中文提示词友好；图视频一体。
strengthsEn: Generous free quota; Chinese-prompt friendly; image+video in one.
weaknesses: 极致画质略逊 Midjourney；会员去水印后才好商用。
weaknessesEn: Slightly behind MJ on peak quality; watermark until paid.
bestFor: 国内创作者做社媒配图、短视频素材，预算有限。
bestForEn: China-based creators making social imgs & short-video assets on a budget.

name: Sora
priceDetail: ChatGPT  Plus 内含 Sora；独立高阶套餐按视频分辨率/时长计费。
priceDetailEn: Included with ChatGPT Plus; higher tiers by resolution/duration.
summary: OpenAI 文生视频，画面连贯、物理合理，长镜头能力强。
summaryEn: OpenAI text-to-video; coherent frames, plausible physics, strong long shots.
strengths: 运动连贯性好；理解复杂指令；与 ChatGPT 生态打通。
strengthsEn: Coherent motion; follows complex prompts; ChatGPT integration.
weaknesses: 配额有限；长视频仍易崩；国内访问需合规渠道。
weaknessesEn: Limited quota; long videos still fragile; access restrictions in CN.
bestFor: 做叙事短片、广告分镜、概念可视化的创作者。
bestForEn: Creators doing narrative shorts, ad storyboards, concept viz.

name: 可灵
priceDetail: 每日免费生成点数；会员解锁高清、长时长与加速。
priceDetailEn: Daily free credits; membership unlocks HD, longer duration, faster.
summary: 国产视频生成标杆，运动自然、支持图生视频，国内可直连。
summaryEn: China's leading video gen; natural motion, image-to-video, accessible in CN.
strengths: 国内直连稳定；图生视频强；性价比高。
strengthsEn: Stable CN access; strong img2vid; good value.
weaknesses: 免费额度有限；复杂指令偶有偏差。
weaknessesEn: Limited free quota; occasional prompt drift.
bestFor: 国内做短视频、电商素材、口播视频的团队。
bestForEn: CN teams making short videos, e-commerce, talking-head clips.

name: ElevenLabs
priceDetail: 免费版每月有限字符；付费解锁高保真语音克隆与商用授权。
priceDetailEn: Free monthly chars; paid unlocks HD voice clone & commercial license.
summary: 语音合成与克隆天花板，多语种、情感自然，播客/有声书神器。
summaryEn: Best-in-class TTS & voice clone; multilingual, natural; podcast/audiobook magic.
strengths: 拟真度最高；支持几十种语言；配音/克隆一条龙。
strengthsEn: Most realistic; dozens of languages; dubbing+clone pipeline.
weaknesses: 中文音色选择少于英文；商用需付费授权。
weaknessesEn: Fewer CN voices than EN; commercial use needs paid license.
bestFor: 做有声内容、多语种配音、虚拟主播的创作者。
bestForEn: Creators doing audiobooks, multilingual dubbing, VTubers.

name: Suno
priceDetail: 免费每日生成次数；付费解锁更长时长与商用版权。
priceDetailEn: Free daily generations; paid unlocks longer songs & commercial rights.
summary: 一句话生成带人声的完整歌曲，旋律自然，玩梗神器。
summaryEn: Generate full songs with vocals from a prompt; natural melody, fun.
strengths: 出歌快；带人声与编曲；风格多。
weaknesses: 歌词随机性大；商用版权需看清套餐。
weaknessesEn: Lyrics random; check commercial rights per plan.
bestFor: 想快速做背景音乐、 demo 曲目、玩梗视频配乐的人。
bestForEn: People needing quick BGM, demos, meme soundtracks.

name: Cursor
priceDetail: 免费版有限额度；Pro 解锁无限补全与更强模型调用。
priceDetailEn: Free limited quota; Pro unlocks unlimited completions & stronger models.
summary: 最火的 AI 代码编辑器，整库理解、多文件改写，程序员标配。
summaryEn: Most popular AI code editor; repo-aware, multi-file edits; devs' default.
strengths: 整项目上下文；Tab 补全顺；Agent 模式能跑任务。
strengthsEn: Whole-repo context; smooth Tab; Agent mode runs tasks.
weaknesses: 重度使用烧 token；大项目偶有漂移。
weaknessesEn: Heavy use burns tokens; drift on huge projects.
bestFor: 日常写代码的开发者，尤其想提升产能的。
bestForEn: Developers wanting a real productivity boost.

name: Perplexity
priceDetail: 免费版带广告式答案；Pro 解锁更强模型与无限制搜索。
priceDetailEn: Free ad-style answers; Pro unlocks stronger models & unlimited search.
summary: AI 搜索鼻祖，答案带引用来源，查资料比传统搜索省事。
summaryEn: Pioneer AI search; cited answers; easier than classic search for research.
strengths: 答案有出处；支持追问；聚合多源。
weaknesses: 深度中文资料弱；Pro 才够用。
weaknessesEn: Weak on deep CN sources; Pro needed for heavy use.
bestFor: 做调研、查事实、要可追溯来源的学生与打工人。
bestForEn: Students/workers researching with need for traceable sources.

name: 扣子
priceDetail: 个人免费搭建 Bot 与Workflow；团队版按资源计费。
priceDetailEn: Free personal Bot/Workflow; team plan by resources.
summary: 零代码搭 Bot 和工作流，接插件/知识库，国内低代码 Agent 首选。
summaryEn: No-code Bot & workflow builder with plugins/knowledge; top CN low-code Agent.
strengths: 可视化拖拽；插件多；国内可直连发布。
strengthsEn: Visual drag; many plugins; publishable in CN.
weaknesses: 复杂逻辑需写代码节点；企业级治理弱。
weaknessesEn: Complex logic needs code nodes; weak enterprise governance.
bestFor: 想快速搭客服/运营/自动化 Bot 的个人与小企业。

name: Canva
priceDetail: 免费海量模板；Pro 解锁高级素材、品牌套件与 AI 功能。
priceDetailEn: Free huge template lib; Pro unlocks premium assets, brand kit, AI.
summary: 在线设计国民级工具，海报/PPT/社媒图拖拽即出，AI 加持。
summaryEn: Nation-level online design; posters/PPT/social by drag; AI-boosted.
strengths: 模板极多；零门槛；团队协作顺。
strengthsEn: Tons of templates; zero learning curve; smooth collaboration.
weaknesses: 高级素材需 Pro；深度排版不如专业软件。
weaknessesEn: Premium assets need Pro; less depth than pro software.
bestFor: 做日常视觉物料、PPT、社媒图的运营与设计小白。
bestForEn: Ops & design newbies making daily visuals, PPT, social.

name: Notion
priceDetail: 个人免费；Plus/Team 解锁 AI 写作与高级权限。
priceDetailEn: Free personal; Plus/Team unlock AI writing & advanced perms.
summary: 笔记+数据库+Wiki 一体，AI 助手帮忙写与整理，团队知识库标配。
summaryEn: Notes+DB+Wiki in one; AI helps write/organize; team KB standard.
strengths: 块结构灵活；模板生态大；AI 摘要/写作好用。
strengthsEn: Flexible blocks; big template ecosystem; handy AI summarize/write.
weaknesses: 国内访问偶发卡；离线弱。
weaknessesEn: Occasional lag in CN; weak offline.
bestFor: 做个人知识管理、团队文档与项目追踪的人。
bestForEn: People doing PKM, team docs, project tracking.

name: 沉浸式翻译
priceDetail: 免费额度够日常；会员解锁高阶模型与无限量。
priceDetailEn: Free quota for daily use; membership unlocks premium models & unlimited.
summary: 划词/网页双语对照翻译插件，看外网文档、视频字幕神器。
summaryEn: Bilingual inline translator; great for foreign docs & subtitles.
strengths: 对照排版好；支持多种翻译引擎；视频字幕翻译。
strengthsEn: Clean bilingual layout; multiple engines; subtitle translate.
weaknesses: 高阶模型需会员；个别站点样式冲突。
weaknessesEn: Premium models need membership; occasional site CSS clash.
bestFor: 常看英文网页、论文、视频的中英双语用户。
bestForEn: Bilingual users reading EN web, papers, videos.
